title: TBProfiler, Mykrobe, and catalogue versions
dek: Tools are not the WHO catalogue. They implement a snapshot of it (or a different database) plus species calling. Version, database date, and PE/PPE masking belong in the methods line.
story: TBProfiler, Mykrobe, SAM-TB, MTBseq, and cousins turn a BAM/FASTQ into species, lineage, and resistance calls. They are software. The WHO mutation catalogue is a graded table with a year. A 2019 TBProfiler BDQ call and a 2023 catalogue-aware call are different objects. Write the tool version and the catalogue edition on every clinical report.

Defaults differ: minimum allele frequency for heteroresistance, whether to report LoF in pncA, whether phylogenetic SNPs are suppressed, which PE/PPE regions are masked for clustering. Two labs on the same FASTQ can disagree without either being “bad at TB.”
These tools also speciate. A confident M. abscessus should never receive an MTBC INH call. If species and DST disagree, believe speciation first.
deepTitle: What to freeze for an outbreak paper
deep: Freeze the container/hash, not just “TBProfiler latest.”
Re-running last year’s MDR cohort with catalogue 2nd ed will move BDQ/LZD/DLM rows. That is not a new epidemic.
tNGS panels may use a different variant interpreter than WGS. Name both.
Do not paste Mycobrowser as a substitute catalogue.
